items.title: Remove public CLI Authority bundle generator entrypoints
items.context: Delete or de-scope buildAuthorityTrustProfileBundle/generate bundle write paths so public CLI no longer creates basic or senior server-owned bundle material.
items.userSees: Lattice CLI no longer offers or documents local generation of Authority bundle files.

happy.desc: source search shows no public CLI command or task generates lattice_authority_trust.env or lattice_senior_* bundles

edge.desc: existing authority consumption and receipt verification paths still read env/config values

adversarial.desc: senior bundle generation cannot be triggered through CLI code paths

verificationEvidence.command: rg "buildAuthorityTrustProfileBundle|writeAuthorityTrustProfileBundle|generate the bundle|generate .*bundle locally|lattice_senior_.*generated|locally in the target workspace" packages/main/src docs
verificationEvidence.note: No matches remained for public Authority bundle generation entrypoints or wording.
Focused smokes consume hand-written Authority handoff fixtures and no longer call local basic or senior bundle generation.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-client-smoke.js && node packages/main/dist/tasks/authority-status-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Focused authority client and status smokes passed after generator removal; they directly write operator/server handoff fixtures and prove existing env/trust consumption still reads server-provided config values.

items.title: Update public CLI docs to consumer-only wording
items.context: Replace local generation wording with server/operator-provided file handoff and keep public docs free of server-side generator internals.
items.userSees: CLI docs say operators provide the files; CLI users source/read them and do not generate them.

happy.desc: docs describe authority_trust/client env files as server-provided

edge.desc: normal developer path still does not require PROJECT_ID or GATE_ACTOR variables

adversarial.desc: public docs do not expose private server generation steps

verificationEvidence.command: rg "generate the bundle|generate .*bundle locally|locally in the target workspace" docs/guide.md docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-authority-live-integration.md docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-cli-authority-client-receipt-ref.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs now describe operator/server-provided handoff files consumed by the CLI, with ordinary developer files separated from advanced/live runner senior files.
No public docs reference CLI generator internals or senior generated bundle wording.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "ordinary developers should not need senior files|PROJECT_ID.*only needed once you switch|GATE_ACTOR" docs/guide.md docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-cli-authority-client-receipt-ref.md
verificationEvidence.note: Public docs now state ordinary developers consume the basic handoff pair and do not need senior files; PROJECT_ID and GATE_ACTOR variables are documented only for live runner or receipt/gate-consumption flows.

items.title: Verify CLI tests after cleanup
items.context: Adjust tests that previously covered generation so they cover consumer-only behavior, or remove generation-specific smoke coverage when it no longer matches product boundary.
items.userSees: CLI authority tests still pass for receipt verify/write/consume and no longer depend on local bundle generation.

happy.desc: authority client/status smoke tests pass after cleanup

edge.desc: build passes with generation imports removed

adversarial.desc: search/test coverage prevents accidental reintroduction of local senior bundle generation

verificationEvidence.note: TypeScript build passed after resolving trust-env sidecar paths relative to the loaded trust env file and after adjusting the handoff smoke coverage.

Authority client/status smokes passed with server-style handoff fixtures: bundleRoot holds lattice_authority_trust.env pointing to ./lattice_staging-client.env while a separate consumer cwd contains a conflicting sidecar, proving the CLI resolves the key beside the trust env file.
Authority status smoke passed with direct consumer fixture handoff files.

verificationEvidence.command: rg "generate the bundle|generate .*bundle locally|locally in the target workspace|regenerated on the destination machine|buildAuthorityTrustProfileBundle|writeAuthorityTrustProfileBundle" README.md docs packages/main/src
verificationEvidence.note: Residual search returned no matches, including README, so public docs/source no longer advertise local bundle generation or expose the removed generator symbols.
